_note: All eight checks need nothing more than the cluster's Metrics API (per-Pod CPU), which requires cluster monitoring to be running — enabled on the CRC test cluster on 2026-09-11 (two CVO overrides removed) plus user-workload monitoring. Without it every HPA utilisation figure reads <unknown> and the HPA never leaves minReplicas, so the four metrics-dependent checks fail loudly rather than being skipped. imagePullPolicy=Always forces a re-pull of the mutable samples/hello-dcs:1.0 tag.

steps.run: envsubst < deployment.yaml | oc apply -f - && oc apply -f service.yaml && oc patch deployment/hello-dcs --type=json -p '[{"op":"add","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/imagePullPolicy","value":"Always"}]' && oc rollout status deploy/hello-dcs --timeout=180s

url="http://hello-dcs.$(oc project -q).svc:8080"; end=$(( $(date +%s) + 120 )); for i in $(seq 1 8); do ( while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$end" ]; do curl -s -o /dev/null "$url"; done ) & done; wait; echo load finished
